verdict.rationale: ReadMe explicitly ships a per-project MCP server that gives AI agents a live connection to the published docs and API spec, with analytics tracking calls, queries, and endpoints hit; this was independently confirmed via a live JSON-RPC handshake against docs.readme.com/mcp and via llms.txt-based search/markdown mirrors for page content retrieval. Missing for 10: independent third-party (non-ReadMe-hosted) confirmation of the MCP server's search-tool behavior on a customer's own docs site beyond ReadMe's own documentation.
